paper_title: Automatic Evaluation of Attribution by Large Language Models
caption: Domain distribution of our annotated AttrEval-GenSearch test set (covering 12 domains in total).
model_annotation: The pie chart illustrates the distribution of 12 domains represented in an annotated test set used for evaluating attribution by large language models. The chart is divided into twelve slices, each representing a different domain. The largest slice, colored in a deep pink, represents Business at approximately 18.4%, followed by Pet & Animal at 8.2%, History at 8.2%, Econ. & Fin. at 5.9%, and Science at 6.7%. The next largest slices are AI/NLP Research at 24.3% (colored in a dark blue), Med & Health at approximately 6.7%, Law at 5.1%, Math at 1.2%, Geography at 2.7%, Game & Anime at 1.2%, and NLP at 7.1% (colored in a lighter blue). A legend is included, providing the corresponding color to each domain label.  The slices appear to be ordered from largest to smallest in terms of their area.
